svg.desc: Illustrative Core UI wireframe with repository navigation, document tree, article and contents. Not a browser capture.

g.text: A common structure for knowledge that stays useful as projects
This document is the entrypoint to the documentation standards for projects built
with the Hypatia model. It defines the shared documentation structure and directs
authors to the standards and reusable models for each documentation category.
The shared hierarchy separates public documentation from internal documentation,
Directory names do not grant or restrict access. This public-repository sample
Exploratory Core UI mockup · Illustrative wireframe, not a browser capture
